Across markets, travelers move between inspiration and booking multiple times, using search to validate choices before committing. How to Fix It
The address may be misspelled or may not exist. Try one or more of the following:
  • Send the message again following these steps: In Outlook, open this non-delivery report (NDR) and choose Send Again from the Report ribbon. In Outlook on the web, select this NDR, then select the link "To send this message again, click here." Then delete and retype the entire recipient address. If prompted with an Auto-Complete List suggestion don't select it. After typing the complete address, click Send.
  • Contact the recipient (by phone, for example) to check that the address exists and is correct.
  • The recipient may have set up email forwarding to an incorrect address. Ask them to check that any forwarding they've set up is working correctly.
  • Clear the recipient Auto-Complete List in Outlook or Outlook on the web by following the steps in this article: Fix email delivery issues for error code 5.1.1 in Office 365, and then send the message again. Retype the entire recipient address before selecting Send.
If the problem continues, forward this message to your email admin. If you're an email admin, refer to the More Info for Email Admins section below.

Was this helpful? Send feedback to Microsoft.

More Info for Email Admins
Status code: 550 5.1.1

This error occurs because the sender sent a message to an email address outside of Office 365, but the address is incorrect or doesn't exist at the destination domain. The error is reported by the recipient domain's email server, but most often it must be fixed by the person who sent the message. If the steps in the How to Fix It section above don't fix the problem, and you're the email admin for the recipient, try one or more of the following:

The email address exists and is correct - Confirm that the recipient address exists, is correct, and is accepting messages.

Synchronize your directories - If you have a hybrid environment and are using directory synchronization make sure the recipient's email address is synced correctly in both Office 365 and in your on-premises directory.

Errant forwarding rule - Check for forwarding rules that aren't behaving as expected. Forwarding can be set up by an admin via mail flow rules or mailbox forwarding address settings, or by the recipient via the Inbox Rules feature.

Mail flow settings and MX records are not correct - Misconfigured mail flow or MX record settings can cause this error. Check your Office 365 mail flow settings to make sure your domain and any mail flow connectors are set up correctly. Also, work with your domain registrar to make sure the MX records for your domain are configured correctly.

For more information and additional tips to fix this issue, see Fix email delivery issues for error code 550 5.1.1 in Office 365.

Get Your App Ready for Real Users

Take your project from prototype to production with these essential integrations and features.

 
 
 

Critical app components:

 

Store & manage data

  • Add a database to your app: Learn how to persistently store user data and application state
 

Integrate any API

  • Add secrets to your projects: how to securely add API keys to connect to other software you want
 

Secure user access

  • Implement Replit Auth: Add user authentication in minutes without complex setup
 

Pre-launch checklist:

  • Test your database connections with sample data
  • Verify authentication flows for different user types
  • Implement proper error handling for API failures
  • Set up monitoring to track usage and performance
  • Create a simple onboarding process for new users
 

These integrations will transform your project into a robust application that's ready for real-world users.

Looking forward to seeing what you launch!
The Replit Team

My Exact BookingKoala Setup

In this video, I walk through my exact BookingKoala setup — how I would set it up today if I were starting over from scratch. This is based on real-world experience growing King of Maids and working with thousands of BookingKoala users at different stages of their business.


Over the years, I’ve seen what works, what wastes time, and what quietly limits how much money a service business can make. Most setups are overcomplicated, poorly structured, or built around advice that sounds good but doesn’t scale well in practice. This video focuses on what actually matters when setting up BookingKoala so you can maximize efficiency, save time, and put your energy where it belongs — growing your business.


I break down how I think about structure, pricing logic, services, automation, and workflows — not from theory, but from experience running a large service business and seeing patterns across thousands of real setups. The goal isn’t perfection; it’s clarity, simplicity, and leverage.


What you’ll learn in this video:

✅ How I’d structure BookingKoala if I were starting today

✅ Which settings actually impact revenue and efficiency

✅ What most people overthink (and should ignore)

✅ How to save time with a cleaner, simpler setup

✅ How to avoid common mistakes that slow growth


If you’re using BookingKoala — or considering it — this video gives you a clear reference point for building a setup that supports growth instead of getting in the way.

dialpad_emails.subject: Replit Product Updates - First Half of January
dialpad_emails.body:
Build iOS mobile apps in Replit + $15K in contest prizes 👀

Thursday, January 22, 2026

We’re barely a few weeks into the year and the Replit product factory is already running hot.

If the last year was about agents getting smarter, this year is about putting them (and you) everywhere.

Over the past two weeks we’ve shipped a wave of updates that make it easier to ship native mobile apps, inspect what your agents are really doing, and wire in the latest LLMs—all without leaving Replit.

But before we get into the bits and bytes, some words of inspiration:

 

💡 Words of Inspiration

Replit exists so that more people can shape the software running the world—not just read about it.

“The future is already here — it’s just not evenly distributed.”

— William Gibson, science fiction author

Everything in this email is about pushing more of that future into your browser: powerful runtimes, stronger agents, and native apps you can ship from a prompt.

 

🔥 Highlights

  • Spin up native iOS apps from a prompt, preview via QR code, and ship to the App Store from Replit
  • Cleaner tool call UI in Agent Chat so you can see what your agents are doing at a glance
  • Automation step graph preview so agent builders get feedback in seconds, not minutes
  • Private apps on free plans, with a small “Made with Replit” badge you can remove with Core
  • replit ai  in Shell + new GPT, Claude, and Gemini models in AI Integrations
  • Node.js security patch rolled out across Agent environments and Node apps
 

📱 Build native iOS apps from a prompt

You can now go from idea → installable iOS app without ever touching Xcode.

Ask Replit’s Agent to “build a habit‑tracking iOS app with login, a Postgres database, and Stripe for subscriptions,” and it generates a full React Native project wired up with your stack.

  • Plug in databases, Stripe, or OpenAI without hand‑rolling boilerplate
  • Scan a QR code with Expo Go to preview your app instantly on a real device
  • When you’re ready, publish to the App Store in a click from Replit

Learn more here.

 

🤑$15K Mobile Buildathon

To celebrate mobile shipping on Replit, we’re running a $15,000 Mobile Buildathon.

Ship something weird, useful, or unapologetically ambitious on the new mobile stack:

  • Stress‑test the new mobile flow end to end
  • Get direct feedback from the Replit team and community
  • Compete for a share of $15K in prizes

Learn more here.

 

🧠 Cleaner tool calls in Agent Chat

If you live in Agent Chat, this one should make your runs a lot less noisy.

We redesigned the tool call UI so you can understand what’s happening without scrolling through a wall of logs:

  • Tool calls are now shown in compact, grouped rows with stacked icons
  • File edits and creations link straight into a diff panel for fast review
  • The whole timeline is more skimmable when you’re debugging complex agent workflows

Open Agent Chat, kick off a run, and you’ll see the new layout in action.

Learn more here.

📌 Other new features

  • Node.js security patch: All Agent dev environments and hosted Node apps have been upgraded to secure Node versions, so you stay protected by default—just republish if it’s been a while.
  • Automation step graph preview: See your automation workflow graph in seconds instead of minutes, so you can catch wiring issues early and iterate faster on agents.
  • Private apps on free plans: Keep projects private even on the free tier, with a small “Made with Replit” badge that you can remove by upgrading to Replit Core.
  • replit ai  in Shell + new models: Call Replit AI directly from Shell with the replit ai   command, and experiment with the latest GPT, Claude, and Gemini models through AI Integrations.

Get the full details on all the latest product updates from the January 16 and the January 9 changelogs.

📹 Videos & tutorials

Want to see these features in action?

Watch the latest Replit walkthroughs on YouTube to build, design, and ship your apps in one session.

We’ll keep adding new demos as more of you ship on the updated stack.

🔮 Looking Ahead

We’re going to keep pushing on the same themes: make it faster to go from idea → shipped app, make Agent more trustworthy as a teammate, and give you more control over where and how your apps run.

That's a wrap for the first half of January. We'll have more exciting updates to share at the end of the month, until then happy new year and keep sharing your apps.

All the best,

Ron  @ Replit (aka "Blade Ronner")
Content Marketing Lead

Sent by Replit

1001 E Hillsdale Blvd, Suite 400, Foster City, CA 94404

Unknown To address

How to Fix It
The email address might be misspelled or it might not exist. Try one or more of the following:
  • Retype the recipient's address, then resend the message - If you're using Outlook, open this non-delivery report message and click Send Again from the menu or ribbon. In Outlook on the web, select this message, and then click the "To send this message again, click here." link located just above the message preview window. In the To or Cc line, delete and then retype the entire recipient's address (ignore any address suggestions). After typing the complete address, click Send to resend the message. If you're using an email program other than Outlook or Outlook on the web, follow its standard way for resending a message. Just be sure to delete and retype the recipient's entire address before resending it.
  • Remove the recipient from the recipient Auto-Complete List, then resend the message - If you're using Outlook or Outlook on the web, follow the steps in the "Remove the recipient from the recipient Auto-Complete List" section of this article. Then resend the message. Be sure to delete and retype the recipient's entire address before clicking Send.
  • Contact the recipient by some other means, (by phone, for example) to confirm you're using the right address. Ask them if they've set up an email forwarding rule that could be forwarding your message to an incorrect address.
If the problem continues, forward this message to your email admin. If you're an email admin, refer to the More Info for Email Admins section below.

Was this helpful? Send feedback to Microsoft.

More Info for Email Admins
Status code: 550 5.1.351

When Office 365 tried to send the message, the external email server returned an error stating that the recipient is unknown or the mailbox is unavailable. This error was reported by an email server outside Office 365.

If you or the sender can't fix the problem, contact the responsible party's email admin - Give them the error code and error message from this non-delivery report (NDR) to help them troubleshoot the issue. To determine who the responsible party might be, check the error for information about where the problem is happening. For example, look for a domain name like contoso.com. A domain name in the error might suggest who is responsible for the error. It could be the recipient's email server, or it could be a third-party service that your organization or the recipient's organization is using to process or filter email messages.

Although the sender might be able to fix the issue by correcting the recipient address, it's likely that only the recipient's email admin can fix the problem. Unfortunately, it's unlikely Office 365 Support will be able to help with these kinds of externally reported errors.

dialpad_emails.subject: January Update: Validation rules, Sub path configuration, and more
dialpad_emails.body:
View in browser

January 2025

Product Update

Validation rules for input fields

We’ve added validation rules, making it easy to prevent incomplete or invalid responses at the question level.


For example, you can limit how many options a respondent can choose in a multi-select question helping teams collect cleaner, more reliable data without manual cleanup.

Try validation rules 

Run Formbricks on a subpath

We’ve added support for running Formbricks under a custom base path like 

/formbricks instead of the root domain. This makes it easier to deploy Formbricks behind reverse proxies, on shared domains, or as part of an existing platform.


This was a highly requested feature for self-hosted teams. Keep the feedback coming, we’re excited to keep improving Formbricks with you!

Try now

Standard webhook protocol

We have rolled out webhook signature security that follows industry best practices for reliability.


Each webhook now includes an auto-generated signing secret and uses HMAC-SHA256 signing, allowing you to verify that requests genuinely originate from Formbricks.

Start using webhooks

Custom HTML scripts

On-premise users can now add custom HTML scripts to link surveys, making it easy to embed tools like Google Tag, Facebook Pixel, or other third-party integrations. 


Scripts load with the survey page and can be managed at the workspace level to stay consistent across surveys, giving you more flexibility and control, for advanced tracking and customization needs.

Try now 

More improvements

  • 🕒 Draft surveys now auto-save so your work is never lost.
  • 🌐 Optionally capture respondent IP addresses when required, with privacy-first controls.
  • 🖱️ Survey answers can now be prefilled more reliably using option IDs, including multi-question blocks.
  • 🎵 MP3 files are now supported in surveys and survey editor.
  • 🌍 Create multi-language surveys using language variations (e.g. es_MX and es_ES).
­

Life is short, craft something irresistible!
The Formbricks Team 🤍

dialpad_emails.subject: Expand your reach — get your Replit App on mobile app stores
dialpad_emails.body:
Take Your App to Mobile Devices

Ready to reach millions of mobile users? Learn how to transform your Replit project into a native mobile app for iOS and Android.

 
 

Create your mobile app:

  • Watch — create a mobile app from your Replit project: Step-by-step tutorial for converting your web app
  • Transform your existing code into a mobile-friendly format
  • Add native mobile features and functionality
  • Test your app on virtual devices before submission
 

Publish to app stores:

  • Watch — publish your mobile app to app stores: Complete guide to the submission process
  • Navigate Apple App Store requirements and review guidelines
  • Submit your app to Google Play Store efficiently
  • Set up app store listings that attract downloads
 

Mobile app best practices:

  • Design Responsively: Ensure your app looks great on various screen sizes
  • Optimize Performance: Mobile users expect fast, smooth experiences
  • Implement Push Notifications: Keep users engaged and returning
  • Consider Offline Mode: Allow core features to work without internet
  • Simplify Navigation: Mobile interfaces need intuitive, finger-friendly designs
 

Submission checklist:

  • Create compelling app icons and screenshots
  • Write clear, keyword-rich descriptions
  • Set up developer accounts on both platforms
  • Prepare privacy policies and terms of service
  • Plan your pricing strategy (free, paid, or freemium)
 

Expanding to mobile can dramatically increase your user base and open new monetization opportunities. Start building your mobile presence today!

Happy Publishing!
The Replit Team

dialpad_emails.body:
hi there, 
     just a quick question,  i already have other privete cleaning jobs. 
how would that work with you guys? would it be conflict on interest? 

thanks
From: Sales Sydneypremiumcleaning.com.au <sales@sydneypremiumcleaning.com.au>
Sent: Tuesday, 3 February 2026 10:00 AM
To: melissaneiva@hotmail.com <melissaneiva@hotmail.com>
Subject: Independent Contractor - General Information
 
Hi Melissa!
Thank you for your interest in working with Sydney Premium Cleaning.
Below is some general information about the Independent Contractor (Cleaner/Provider) role to help you understand how we operate.
Role Type
This position is offered on an independent contractor basis, not as an employee role. You will be providing cleaning services to our clients under your own ABN.
Work Arrangement
  • Flexible scheduling based on job availability and your preferred working days
  • Jobs may include regular/recurring cleans, deep cleans, end-of-lease cleans, and occasional ad-hoc bookings
  • You may accept or decline jobs depending on your availability
Payment
  • Payment is made per job or per hour (depending on the booking)
  • Payments are sent every Friday for completed jobs
  • As a contractor, you are responsible for your own tax, superannuation, and insurance obligations
Requirements
  • Valid ABN
  • Own cleaning equipment and supplies (unless otherwise specified)
  • Ability to travel to client locations
  • Attention to detail and a professional attitude
  • Previous cleaning experience is preferred but not always required
Expectations
  • Deliver high-quality cleaning services that meet our standards
  • Communicate clearly and promptly regarding job confirmations or issues
  • Maintain professionalism with clients at all times
  • Follow provided job notes and instructions carefully
What We Offer
  • Consistent work opportunities as demand grows
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Support with scheduling, client communication, and job coordination
If this arrangement aligns with what you’re looking for, please reply to this email and we’ll be happy to move forward with the next steps.
Cheers,
Gohan Hasan

sydneypremiumcleaning.com.au

We used a ‘Lead Compass’ system with them and after a few weeks they were getting eight times their spend back in booked jobs and have since generated over $15k with the system.


Now they had no more capacity to take jobs but given you’ve got a full team, I believe the system would work perfectly with your first clean discount.


Want me to send over a quick breakdown on how it could make you the first name people see when searching for cleaning work in Sydney?


Thanks,

dialpad_emails.subject: Independent Contractor - General Information
dialpad_emails.body:
Hi Melissa!
Thank you for your interest in working with Sydney Premium Cleaning.
Below is some general information about the Independent Contractor (Cleaner/Provider) role to help you understand how we operate.
Role Type
This position is offered on an independent contractor basis, not as an employee role. You will be providing cleaning services to our clients under your own ABN.
Work Arrangement
  • Flexible scheduling based on job availability and your preferred working days
  • Jobs may include regular/recurring cleans, deep cleans, end-of-lease cleans, and occasional ad-hoc bookings
  • You may accept or decline jobs depending on your availability
Payment
  • Payment is made per job or per hour (depending on the booking)
  • Payments are sent every Friday for completed jobs
  • As a contractor, you are responsible for your own tax, superannuation, and insurance obligations
Requirements
  • Valid ABN
  • Own cleaning equipment and supplies (unless otherwise specified)
  • Ability to travel to client locations
  • Attention to detail and a professional attitude
  • Previous cleaning experience is preferred but not always required
Expectations
  • Deliver high-quality cleaning services that meet our standards
  • Communicate clearly and promptly regarding job confirmations or issues
  • Maintain professionalism with clients at all times
  • Follow provided job notes and instructions carefully
What We Offer
  • Consistent work opportunities as demand grows
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Support with scheduling, client communication, and job coordination
If this arrangement aligns with what you’re looking for, please reply to this email and we’ll be happy to move forward with the next steps.
Cheers,
Gohan Hasan
0426 413 984
sydneypremiumcleaning.com.au

dialpad_emails.subject: Invitation to a Sydney Business Leaders Breakfast
dialpad_emails.body:
Hi team at Sydney Premium Cleaning,

I appreciate that this message is a little out of the blue, but I wanted to personally reach out and extend an invitation to a business breakfast we’re hosting at The Rydges in North Sydney on Friday, 27th February. The reason I’m contacting you specifically is because one of our members mentioned that they would love to specifically connect with a professional in your field, and I’d love to make that introduction for them and potentially create a valuable opportunity for you at the same time.

To give you a sense of the room you’d be walking into, we’re a group of 45+ professionals who meet weekly to support each other’s businesses through warm referrals, strategic introductions, and trusted relationships. The group operates at an exceptionally high level and in the last 12 months alone we’ve passed over $11 million in closed business (averaging nearly $1 million a month is wild). It’s a strong, high-performing environment filled with genuinely good people who hold meaningful networks. You never know where a conversation or one introduction might lead, and given that your profession has been specifically requested, there may be some immediate value for you.

This isn’t the usual “walk around the room awkwardly handing out business cards” kind of networking. The meeting is structured, relaxed, and very welcoming. When you arrive, there’s about 20 minutes of open networking over coffee and breakfast, followed by a sit-down format with a full hot and cold buffet that you can enjoy through the meeting without needing to worry about working the room.

As a visitor, you’ll have a brief opportunity to introduce yourself to the group, and from there you can simply sit back, get a feel for the dynamic and note down anyone you may want to further connect with after the meeting. You’ll hear short updates from our members on the type of referrals they’re looking for, along with two seven minute presentations from selected members who are always insightful and never too long. The entire meeting runs for around an hour and a half, so you’ll be on your way by about 8:30am to start your day or some people hang around for another 20 minutes or so for some post meeting open networking if you don’t have to shoot off straight away.

If this sounds like something you’d be open to exploring, feel free to reply and I’ll send through a formal invite with booking details. Seats do need to be reserved for catering purposes, and bookings close at 12pm on the Wednesday before the event. If it’s not for you, no stress at all!


--
Best Regards,

Geoff Farrell
Advisor & Business Broker

dialpad_emails.subject: ❄️ January Replit Product Updates
dialpad_emails.body:
Mobile apps in Replit, new voice AI models, private apps for free users, & more

Friday, February 6, 2026

The year is flying by, and so are product updates! January kicked off with our team returning from the holidays recharged and ready to ship.

Here's what we released last month:

  • Build mobile apps directly in Replit, with a simplified App Store submission flow
  • New voice AI models available without any API keys in AI Integrations
  • MORE new models in AI integrations - GPT 5.2, Opus 4.5, & Gemini 3
  • Private apps for free accounts

and more! Let's dive in.

📱Mobile apps in Replit

This is the one we've been building toward. You can now build iOS & Android apps from a simple prompt.

Agent can create mobile apps, with every feature Replit has to offer: databases, Stripe payments, and OpenAI Integrations if you need them.

Scan a QR code to preview instantly on your phone with Expo Go, then publish to the App Store with one click.

New models in AI integrations

The latest and greatest AI models are now available in Integrations: GPT-5.2, Claude Opus 4.5, Gemini 3 Flash Preview, Gemini 3 Pro Preview, Gemini 3 Pro Image Preview.

We've also added audio support for GPT-4o Transcribe and GPT-4o Transcribe Mini for speech-to-text & GPT-4o Audio and GPT-4o Audio Mini for generating speech.

Swap models in your apps with a few clicks. No API key management required. Opus 4.6 & GPT-5.3 coming soon!

📌 Other new features

  • Automation preview graphs – See your automation steps in seconds instead of waiting minutes
  • `replit ai`  Shell command – Chat with LLMs directly in your Shell
  • Redesigned tool calls UI – Cleaner Agent chat with collapsible tool calls
  • Web search in Automations – Build scheduled research tools and news summaries without API keys
  • Open in Replit with prefilled prompts – Create shareable links that open Replit with your prompt already written
  • LinkedIn skills verification – LinkedIn launched AI-powered coding challenges built on Replit

You can find weekly updates and more in our changelog.

📹 Videos & tutorials

I've been shipping tutorials on my channel and the Replit YouTube. Here are some highlights:

 

Mobile deep-dive: A look at what mobile builds are and how they work under-the-hood

 

Claude Code & Replit: Learn how to use Claude Code with Replit

🔮 Looking Ahead

I can't believe January is already over, but we have some really exciting things planned for February & March.

Until then, happy building!

Best,

Matt @ Replit

Sent by Replit

1001 E Hillsdale Blvd, Suite 400, Foster City, CA 94404

dialpad_emails.subject: Re: Alex | Sydney Premium Cleaning appointment is confirmed
dialpad_emails.body:
Hi there, 

For the appointment tomorrow, wanted to let you know a few things: 

1. The house was treated for pest control last week, please mop the timber floor by lifting or moving hallway runners or mats. 

2. Someone in the middle room has moved out, please vacuum / mop under the bed. 

3. Ive left leaf blower on kitchen benchtop, please use for backyard if required. 

4. Key will be under the front door mat. Please leave it back and ONLY use this one key when locking front door after finishing. It’s the upper lock - do not use the chain lock at the front door when leaving. 

5. I will transfer $120 to your account, please share the details. 

All the best and thank you for the time. 

Regards, Aleks

dialpad_emails.subject: Veness cct
dialpad_emails.body:
﻿Good Evening, 

Attached are the photos of the discussed issues (unfortunately it’s a little hard to see in the photos). I was very disappointed with the end result as the house just did not feel clean and dusted.
I’m also a little bit concerned about the people that come in to do the cleaning are the appropriate checks being done for these people. The lady I had was very lovely however could not speak English at all was very hard to communicate with her. I was also promised 2 cleaners for 1 1/2 hours which I only had one cleaner which obviously would take a lot longer. This would not have been an issue if the job have been done properly. I felt that the lady felt very pressured as she was on a timer so her attention for detail was quite rushed as she was told that she only had two hours to do the job.

I do not believe that the work that was done matches the services promised, with the addition of the experience being incredibly disappointing with numerous reschedules and the uncomfortable nature of the clean itself today. 





Kind Regards,

Nadine Thomas

0425 365 925

dialpad_emails.subject: Partnership Proposal
dialpad_emails.body:
Hi there,

I hope you're having a great week.

I’ve been researching professional cleaning services in your area, and I was really impressed by the quality of work and the reputation your team has built.

I am a Lead Generation specialist, and I have developed a strategy to find high-quality residential and commercial cleaning leads specifically in your region. Since I am not based in Australia, I am looking for a reliable, professional partner who can take over these jobs and provide the excellent service your business is known for.

How we can work together:

Zero Risk: I don’t charge any upfront or fixed fees.

Performance-Based: I only ask for a small commission once you’ve completed the job and received payment from the client.

Ready-to-Book Leads: I focus on serious clients who are ready to hire, not just price-shoppers.

If you have the capacity to take on more clients this month, I’d love to have a quick chat or exchange a few messages to discuss how I can start sending leads your way.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

Best regards,

David
WhatsApp: +61 468 147 069
